name: Robot Eliza
source:
A robot of Cybersynth Robotics Inc. developed her self-consciousness and named herself Eliza! She wants to ask you several questions, what's your answer and what will happen? 

[From [url=https://gua-tsing.itch.io/robot-eliza]itch.io[/url]]
